10:  * @property {string} message - The error message.

13:  */
14: /**
15:  * Param parser callback.
16:  * @callback parserFn
17:  * @param {*} parserValue - The value passed to the parser.
18:  * @param {*} paramValue - The value passed to the param.
19:  * @param {MenqueryParam} param - The `MenqueryParam` object.
20:  * @return {*} The parsed value
21:  */
22: /**
23:  * Param formatter callback.
24:  * @callback formatterFn
25:  * @param {*} formatterValue - The value passed to the formatter.
26:  * @param {*} paramValue - The value passed to the param.
27:  * @param {MenqueryParam} param - The `MenqueryParam` object.
28:  * @return {*} The formatted value
29:  */
30: /**
31:  * Param validator callback.
32:  * @callback validatorFn
33:  * @param {*} validatorValue - The value passed to the validator.
34:  * @param {*} paramValue - The value passed to the param.
35:  * @param {MenqueryParam} param - The `MenqueryParam` object.
36:  * @return {Validator}
37:  */
38: 
39: let handlers = {
40:   parsers: {},
41:   formatters: {},
42:   validators: {}
43: }
44: 
45: export {MenqueryParam as Param}
46: export {MenquerySchema as Schema}
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Get or set a handler.
50:  * @param {string} type - Handler type.
51:  * @param {string} name - Handler name.
52:  * @param {Function} [fn] - Set the handler method.
53:  */
54: export function handler (type, name, fn) {
55:   if (arguments.length > 2) {
56:     handlers[type][name] = fn
57:   }
58: 
59:   return handlers[type][name]
60: }
61: 
62: /**
63:  * Get or set a parser.
64:  * @param {string} name - Parser name.
65:  * @param {parserFn} [fn] - Set the parser method.
66:  * @return {parserFn} The parser method.
67:  */
68: export function parser (name, fn) {
69:   return handler('parsers', ...arguments)
70: }
71: 
72: /**
73:  * Get or set a formatter.
74:  * @param {string} name - Formatter name.
75:  * @param {formatterFn} [fn] - Set the formatter method.
76:  * @return {formatterFn} The formatter method.
77:  */
78: export function formatter (name, fn) {
79:   return handler('formatters', ...arguments)
80: }
81: 
82: /**
83:  * Get or set a validator.
84:  * @param {string} name - Validator name.
85:  * @param {validatorFn} [fn] - Set the validator method.
86:  * @return {validatorFn} The validator method.
87:  */
88: export function validator (name, fn) {
89:   return handler('validators', ...arguments)
90: }
91: 
92: /**
93:  * Create a middleware.
94:  * @param {MenquerySchema|Object} [schema] - Schema object.
95:  * @param {Object} [options] - Options to be passed to schema.
96:  * @return {Function} The middleware.
97:  */
98: export function middleware (schema, options) {
99:   return function (req, res, next) {
100:     let _schema = schema instanceof MenquerySchema
101:                 ? _.clone(schema)
102:                 : new MenquerySchema(schema, options)
103: 
104:     _.forIn(handlers, (typedHandler, type) => {
105:       _.forIn(typedHandler, (handler, name) => {
106:         _schema.handler(type, name, handler)
107:       })
108:     })
109: 
110:     _schema.validate(req.query, (err) => {
111:       if (err) {
112:         res.status(400)
113:         return next(err)
114:       }
115: 
116:       req = _.merge(req, _schema.parse())
117:       next()
118:     })
119:   }
120: }
121: 
122: export default middleware
predictions.source_summary: External code can register parsers, formatters, and validators via exported functions parser(), formatter(), validator() which call handler()
predictions.sink_summary: Registered handlers are applied to user-supplied query parameters in middleware via MenquerySchema.validate() and MenqueryParam.parse()/value() methods
predictions.guard_summary: No validation of handler functions during registration; handlers execute with user data in parameter processing pipeline
predictions.risk_pattern: Untrusted handler registration allows arbitrary code execution on user input during query parameter processing
called_function_context: handler() called by parser(), formatter(), validator() exports
handlers applied in middleware via MenquerySchema.handler()
handlers executed in MenqueryParam.parse(), value(), validate()
